qs.q: Which of the following statements about antibody structure is TRUE?
o: Variable regions are identical for all antibodies
Each molecule has two identical heavy and two identical light chains
Disulfide bonds only link the two heavy chains together
Constant regions determine the antigen-binding specificity
qs.e: A typical antibody (immunoglobulin) Y-shaped structure is composed of two identical heavy polypeptide chains and two identical light polypeptide chains, linked by disulfide bonds.
qs.s: Weekly Year 2: Cellular Immunology Exam - June 5, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: The 'J chain' is a polypeptide associated with which antibody structures?
qs.e: The J (joining) chain is required to stabilize pentameric IgM and dimeric IgA.
